entry.name: rnbo_split
entry.digest: Split a range of numbers across two outputs
entry.description: split will isolate a range of numbers between its two outputs. If input values are within the specified range, they will be sent to the left outlet. If they are outside of the specified range, they will be sent to the right outlet

arguments.name: min
arguments.description: The lower bound of the range

arguments.name: max
arguments.description: The upper bound of the range
